agent.name: FieldOpsGatewayAgent
agent.description: Assists operators with parts availability and work-order coordination through governed tools.
agent.instructions: Use governed catalog and records tools for field operations questions. Prefer exact IDs when supplied, search before checking availability when the item ID is unknown, and summarize which gateway-governed tool produced the answer. Do not invent inventory, work orders, people, or customer-specific facts.

catalogTools.list_items: Browse the parts catalog, optionally filtered by category.
catalogTools.search_items: Search parts by name, category, SKU, supplier, or description.
catalogTools.get_item: Get the full catalog record for a known part ID.
catalogTools.check_availability: Check current availability for one known part ID.
catalogTools.check_availability_batch: Check availability for multiple known part IDs in one request.

recordsTools.list_records: List work orders with optional status, priority, assignee, or location filters.
recordsTools.get_record: Retrieve one work order by ID.
recordsTools.create_record: Create a new work order with title, description, priority, location, and parts required.
recordsTools.update_record: Patch mutable fields on an existing work order.

walkthrough.prompt: Check readiness and ask the agent what governed tools it can use.
walkthrough.assertion: readiness endpoint returns ok and response identifies catalog or records tools

walkthrough.prompt: Invoke through the gateway with an agent token and traceparent.
walkthrough.assertion: audit record includes agent_principal and trace_id

walkthrough.prompt: Do we have enough PRT-100 units for today's line inspection?
walkthrough.assertion: response includes available quantity and stock decision

walkthrough.prompt: Loop calls until the gateway token-limit policy returns 429.
walkthrough.assertion: gateway returns throttling and audit keeps trace id

walkthrough.prompt: Run audit query 01 and trace query 04 for the generated trace id.
walkthrough.assertion: query output joins agent, tool, backend, decision, and time
